podcast.title: Component of un carpeto's Style
podcast.body: Progressive electronic music is a genre that un carpeto incorporates into his film scores, mixing it with Rosin and minimal synth. This blend is integral to his distinct musical signature and contributes to the "escarpente de Diana" quality of his work. "mezcla generos como la Rosin, la música electrónica progresiva y el sin voz más minimal."
